closesWhen.classification: every file under src and tests is renamed or moved to the folder of its kind, or is listed outside the catalog on purpose
closesWhen.imports: the file stops importing that target, or the target moves to a kind the file may import
closesWhen.mirror: a test of the required level exists at the mirror path of the source
closesWhen.shape: the class takes the shape of its kind: one class named after its file, a public execute, at most five dependencies, the tool catalog at construction
closesWhen.thrown: the class is thrown where its code path is, or deleted
closesWhen.instructs: the message names a command the CLI declares
closesWhen.composition: composition holds one module per context, plus container, shared and orchestration/
closesWhen.ports: the method gets a caller in src, or leaves the port
closesWhen.sections: the method gets a caller in src, or leaves the section
closesWhen.answers: the plugin answers by a method and its data is a # field
closesWhen.repository: the test reaches the repository through tests/helpers/repository-root.ts
closesWhen.translate: translate names no other host's manifest path
closesWhen.size: the test file is split under 800 lines
closesWhen.limits: the file stops breaking that size limit and leaves its exclusion in biome.json
closesWhen.toolNames: the file reads the tool from its profile instead of naming it
closesWhen.toolSites: the registration moves into the profile or the composition list is rewritten
closesWhen.toolOwn: the file stops naming its own tool
closesWhen.toolIdentifiers: the file stops carrying a tool name in an identifier
closesWhen.exemptProcessExit: the file stops exiting the process and leaves its exclusion in biome.json
closesWhen.exemptGithubUrl: the file stops writing the GitHub API URL, or the adapter is the only one that ever did
closesWhen.exemptDefaultExport: no declaration file needs a default export
closesWhen.exemptProfileImport: the folder stops importing a whole profile
closesWhen.controllerBuildsError: the decision moves to the scenario and the translator renders it: A26 for SyncFailedError, A24 for the rest
closesWhen.profile: the reader names the sections of the tool it reads in its own ports, never the whole profile
